/*
Theme Name: Brine
Theme URI: https://github.com/richtabor/chatgpt-agent-woo-builder
Author: Brine
Author URI: https://example.com/brine
Description: A fermentation-first WooCommerce theme built around starter rituals, pantry depth, and giftable live-flavor systems. Editorial serif headlines on a warm rice-paper surface, with deep-cellar dark sections for subscription and editorial moments.
Version: 1.0.0
Requires at least: 6.4
Tested up to: 6.6
Requires PHP: 7.4
License: GPL v2 or later
License URI: http://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-2.0.html
Text Domain: brine
Tags: full-site-editing, block-patterns, woocommerce
*/

<?php
// Brine product importer — runs WC's built-in CSV importer against /wp-content/uploads/brine-products.csv.

if ( ! defined( 'ABSPATH' ) ) {
    require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
}

if ( ! class_exists( 'WC_Product_CSV_Importer' ) ) {
    $importer_path = WP_PLUGIN_DIR . '/woocommerce/includes/import/class-wc-product-csv-importer.php';
    if ( file_exists( $importer_path ) ) {
        require_once WP_PLUGIN_DIR . '/woocommerce/includes/abstracts/abstract-wc-product-importer.php';
        require_once $importer_path;
    } else {
        echo 'WooCommerce CSV importer class not found' . PHP_EOL;
        exit( 1 );
    }
}

$csv_file = '/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/brine-products.csv';

if ( ! file_exists( $csv_file ) ) {
    echo 'Brine CSV not found at ' . $csv_file . PHP_EOL;
    exit( 1 );
}

$mapping = array(
    'ID'                => 'id',
    'Type'              => 'type',
    'SKU'               => 'sku',
    'Name'              => 'name',
    'Published'         => 'published',
    'Description'       => 'description',
    'Short description' => 'short_description',
    'Regular price'     => 'regular_price',
    'Categories'        => 'category_ids',
    'Images'            => 'images',
);

$params = array(
    'parse'             => true,
    'update_existing'   => false,
    'delimiter'         => ',',
    'prevent_timeouts'  => false,
    'mapping'           => $mapping,
    'lines'             => -1,
    'start_pos'         => 0,
    'end_pos'           => -1,
);

$importer = new WC_Product_CSV_Importer( $csv_file, $params );
$results  = $importer->import();

$imported = isset( $results['imported'] ) ? count( $results['imported'] ) : 0;
$failed   = isset( $results['failed'] ) ? count( $results['failed'] ) : 0;
$updated  = isset( $results['updated'] ) ? count( $results['updated'] ) : 0;
$skipped  = isset( $results['skipped'] ) ? count( $results['skipped'] ) : 0;

echo sprintf(
    'Brine import complete: imported=%d updated=%d skipped=%d failed=%d',
    $imported,
    $updated,
    $skipped,
    $failed
) . PHP_EOL;

if ( $failed > 0 ) {
    foreach ( $results['failed'] as $failure ) {
        if ( is_wp_error( $failure ) ) {
            echo 'Failure: ' . $failure->get_error_message() . PHP_EOL;
        }
    }
}
